{"pages":[{"page":1,"markdown":"# Lecture 9 - Conditional probability
Oct 5, 2026

Def: $P(A|B) = P(A \cap B) / P(B)$, when $P(B) > 0$

read as: prob of A given B

Ex: roll a fair die. A = even, B = at least 4

$P(A \cap B) = 2/6$, $P(B) = 3/6$

so $P(A|B) = 2/3$

Note: $P(A|B)$ is not $P(B|A)$ in general!","blank":false},{"page":2,"markdown":"# Multiplication rule
$P(A \cap B) = P(A) P(B|A)$

Ex: 2 cards, no replacement

$P(\text{both aces}) = 4/52 \times 3/51 = 1/221$

Chain: $P(A \cap B \cap C) = P(A) P(B|A) P(C|A \cap B)$

(sketch: Venn diagram, A and B overlap)

[Diagram: Venn diagram of two overlapping circles labeled A and B]","blank":false},{"page":3,"markdown":"# Law of total probability
If B1, ..., Bk partition S then

$P(A) = \text{sum of } P(A|B_i) P(B_i)$

Ex: 3 machines make 50%, 30%, 20% of parts

defect rates 1%, 2%, 3%

$P(\text{defect}) = .005 + .006 + .006 = .017$","blank":false}]}

{"pages":[{"page":4,"markdown":"# Lecture 10 - Bayes' theorem
Oct 7, 2026

$$P(B_j|A) = \frac{P(A|B_j)P(B_j)}{\sum P(A|B_i)P(B_i)}$$

same machines: part is defective,
prob it came from machine 3?

$= .006 / .017 = 0.353$ (about 35%)

prior 20% -> posterior 35%","blank":false},{"page":5,"markdown":"# Independence

A, B independent iff $P(A \cap B) = P(A)P(B)$

equivalently $P(A|B) = P(A)$

mutually exclusive is NOT independent
(unless one has prob 0)

Ex: two coin flips, H on 1st and H on 2nd are indep","blank":false},{"page":6,"markdown":"# Lecture 11 - Discrete random variables
Oct 9, 2026

$X: S \to \mathbb{R}$, a function on outcomes

prob function $f(x) = P(X = x)$

$f(x) \geq 0$ and $\sum f(x) = 1$

cdf $F(x) = P(X \leq x)$, non-decreasing","blank":false}]}

{"pages":[{"page":7,"markdown":"# Binomial distribution

$X \sim Bin(n, p)$: number of successes in n indep trials

$f(x) = \binom{n}{x} p^x (1-p)^{(n-x)}$, $x = 0..n$

Ex: n = 10, p = 0.3, $P(X=2) = 45(.09)(.7^8) = 0.233$
